args.message:
Fix round_money to use ROUND_HALF_EVEN (FIN-212)

src/money.py used ROUND_HALF_UP despite its docstring claiming
banker's rounding, causing tests/test_money.py to fail. Switch to
ROUND_HALF_EVEN so .005/.015 ties round to the nearest even cent.

args.body:
## Summary
- Fixed `round_money` in `src/money.py` to use `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` (banker's rounding, per FIN-212); it previously used `ROUND_HALF_UP` despite the docstring.
- This was causing the nightly build to fail in `tests/test_money.py` (e.g., `2.675` should round to `2.68` but `2.665` should round down to `2.66`).

## Testing
- CI run `ci-0001` on branch `fix/FIN-212-bankers-rounding` (sha `08d3cd5986`): **passed**.

Fixes the nightly build failure so this ships in today's release.
